item.title: Create an SVG of the Jugaadfest logo
item.dc:creator: Jugaadfest
item.description: Please create a SVG with the following specifications of the colorful logo of Jugaadfest: non-pathified SVG (text as text) components are real text/vector Don’t embed a jpg or png. Substitute the gray colors with another suitable color (not black or white)
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Jugaadfest

Status: filled

Compensation: gratis

Role: logo design

Please create a SVG with the following specifications of the colorful logo of Jugaadfest:

  • non-pathified SVG (text as text)
  • components are real text/vector
  • Don’t embed a jpg or png.
  • Substitute the gray colors with another suitable color (not black or white)

How to Apply:

  • Please talk to us here https://gitter.im/fossasia/fossasia
  • Please follow up on the issue tracker here: https://github.com/fossasia/jugaadfest-artwork/issues/1

Read more on opensourcedesign.net →
